root_cause_criterion.obligation: The admitted strip table must cover every image row exactly once before decompression continues.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed constructor rejects duplicate, out-of-range, and missing strip row numbers before decompression, so rows_covered equals mRaw->dim.y whenever the sink is reached.

nodes.description: When the final missing row reaches checkRowIsInitialized, its written byte count is still smaller than the 4-byte logical row size passed to MSan.

edges.description: The first image row absent from the admitted strip set is the first untouched row later checked by checkRowIsInitialized, which is where MSan aborts.
